goalBodyDe: Die lernende Person kann ausgewählte Bindungs- und Wechselwirkungstypen zwischen Farbstoff-Molekülen und Faser-Molekülen beschreiben und die Eignung von Farbstoffen als Textilfarbstoff beurteilen.
goalTitleEn: Evaluate textile dyes through dye-fiber interactions
goalBodyEn: The learner can describe selected bonding and interaction types between dye molecules and fiber molecules and evaluate the suitability of dyes as textile dyes.
approvalScope: AI V approval for the exact inactive v2 PNG and the exact whole after-goal input only

observations.finding: At actual 360x203, one large NH3+ and SO3- pair is readable, including the opposite charge signs. Reactive and disperse dye labels use larger two-line lettering and are readable as Reaktiv-farbstoff and Dispersions-farbstoff. The O-C contact, solid red covalent link, dashed blue noncovalent contacts and dye placement remain distinguishable. The v1 critical-text blocker is corrected for this exact v2 output.

An NH3+ amino site belongs to the wool ribbon, and the sulfonate label belongs by close grouping to the dye model. The dashed diagonal contact represents electrostatic attraction to the anionic dye without a new covalent bond. The large sauer label bounds the protonated state. The abstract drawing does not claim a complete wool or dye structure, nor exclude additional interactions.

The labeled reactive dye is connected through the schematic fiber-O-C-dye contact with a continuous solid O-C link. This is a product/contact motif, not a complete triazine structure, valence inventory, hydrolysis equation or reaction mechanism. The large kovalent label and dye-class qualifier are coherent with the exact case.

Three neutral dye models lie inside or between polyester ribbons. Blue dashed contacts indicate noncovalent uptake; no charge or solid new fiber-dye bond is drawn. This is consistent with the selected disperse-dye case, without a false washed-away or exterior-only model.

Equal panels, Ausgewählte Beispiele and Farbstoff + Faser + Bedingungen retain selected-system scope. No strength ladder, good/bad hierarchy, universal wash-fastness promise, grading mark or ranking arrow is present.

Friendly abstract hand-drawn image language, recognisable wool/cotton/polyester objects, coherent coral dye symbols and warm panel colors suit the upper-school atomic comparison. Important details are now sufficiently large; no visible technical ID, watermark, logo, copied worksheet layout or implied practical-execution evidence.

At 680x383 the labels, charge notation and contact motifs are readable. GoalCard line 672 uses h-auto max-h-[28rem] w-full object-contain; this 16:9 image is below the approximately 448px cap at 680px width and is not cropped.

The exact after-goal retains the same DE/EN competence, title, prerequisites and profile/cases. Its specific alt text accurately names the three conceptual systems, conditions and absence of a universal ranking; it complements the image rather than rescuing unreadable critical text.

limitations: Conceptual image only; no complete chemical mechanism or molecular structures claimed.
This judgment does not review D/P/A/M, e560, learner work, practical execution, host display acceptance or full M7.
Generation and hashes alone did not determine the verdict; all three actual sizes were viewed.
